title: The folks behind John Wick are back with Karōshi trailer
gist: Lionsgate released the trailer for Karōshi, a dystopian corporate action thriller from John Wick creator Chad Stahelski, written and directed by Takashi Doscher and starring Teo Yoo, hitting theaters February 5, 2027. Entertainment promo with minimal investor signal.

insights.claim: Lionsgate's Karōshi, from John Wick creator Chad Stahelski, opens in theaters on February 5, 2027.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Upcoming theatrical release on Lionsgate's slate leveraging the John Wick brand.

insights.claim: Karōshi is set in a near-future Manhattan corporation, Ikigai Technologies, and dramatizes death from overwork, written and directed by Takashi Doscher.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Corporate-dystopia themes resonate with work-culture anxieties.

insights.claim: The cast includes Teo Yoo, Takehiro Hira, Giancarlo Esposito and Cynthia Erivo.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette

insights.claim: Death from overwork is a real phenomenon in Japan, much of Asia and Sweden, typically via stress-related heart attacks, strokes or suicide.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Societal context for work-culture labor debates.
